title: Hardened demo no-network grep fails on the shipped tree: '^import api/' matches demo_api.gleam's legitimate api_error import
evidence: test.yml:136: VIOLATIONS=$(grep -rn "api_helpers\|^import api/" client/src/demo/ --include="*.gleam" || true)  — running this exact grep at 16144f3 prints 'client/src/demo/demo_api.gleam:18:import api/api_error.{type ApiError}' (exit 0, match found), so VIOLATIONS is non-empty and the step exits 1. demo_api.gleam:18: import api/api_error.{type ApiError}
detail: The r3 'import api/* banned in demo/' fold over-bans: the pure error-type module api/api_error trips it, so the lint step fails on its own tree the moment CI runs. The claimed hardened gate is broken as wired.
recommended_fix: Narrow the grep to network client modules (e.g. '^import api/(vacancy|application|scoring|report|notification|reference_checks|payment|settings|auth)_api') or allowlist api/api_error.

title: lint_demo_network.py hardening did not land: 35-line guard window still bleeds across arm boundaries (reproduced); no DEMO_INTERCEPTED cross-check exists
evidence: window = "\n".join(lines[max(0, idx - 35) : idx]) / guarded = "model.demo_mode" in window or "updated_model.demo_mode" in window — the arm walk-back only names the scope for exemption; the guard check is still a flat 35-line text window. Reproduced at 16144f3: injecting a fresh non-exempt arm 'UserClickedTotallyFakeSynthetic(vid) -> #(model, vacancy_api.get_detail(vid, ApiReturnedVacancyDetail))' 25 lines below the msg.DocumentImageFailed arm's 'case model.demo_mode {' passes the lint (exit 0). The 187-line script contains no reference to demo_update.gleam — DEMO_INTERCEPTED remains hand-synced (comment: 'Keep this in sync with the request messages in demo_update.handle').
detail: The r3 guard required depth-aware arm boundaries and a mechanical DEMO_INTERCEPTED/manifest + never-produced-trigger check; neither landed. A cross-arm guard still satisfies the lint, so the structural pin retains a vacuous-pass mode (pillar 1 holds today only via demo_update interception, verified).
recommended_fix: Scope the guard search to the enclosing arm (stop the window at the arm boundary found by the walk-back), and add the mechanical manifest cross-check against demo_update.handle arms.

title: r2#17 still present: demo comparison ids and sweep-nudge dismissals still write to real web storage (no demo branch)
evidence: UserToggledComparison arm: 'save_comparison_ids(new_ids)' (client.gleam:3527, also 3541/3548) and UserDismissedSweepNudge arm: 'save_dismissed_sweep_nudges(set.to_list(updated_dismissed))' (client.gleam:4938) — neither has a demo_mode branch, and grep confirms UserToggledComparison/UserDismissedSweepNudge/UserClearedComparison appear nowhere in demo_update.gleam, so in demo mode they fall through to these storage writes with demo ids (a-aoife etc.).
detail: Demo-scoped ids persist in sessionStorage/localStorage beyond refresh — a non-persistence-pillar exception (client-side storage only, no real endpoint writes). Same class as r2#17, unfixed at this head.
recommended_fix: Skip storage writes when model.demo_mode is True, or use a demo-scoped storage key.
